subject: Subprocessor Exhibit Update and Procurement Q&A
body:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme-corp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: updated subprocessor exhibit for procurement checklist

Hi Jordan,

We're finalizing the procurement packet for Redwood and need an updated Subprocessor Exhibit showing current vendors, country of processing, and whether they process content or metadata. Can you: 

- Share the latest exhibit (PDF preferred)
- Confirm which subprocessors have access to persistent user content vs telemetry
- Provide a contact for SOC2 evidence or a snapshot we can reference in our audit tracker

If possible, can you get this to us by EOD your time so we can keep the RFP timeline?

Thanks,
Marta Lopez
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corporation

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: updated subprocessor exhibit for procurement checklist

Hi Marta — thanks for the heads up. We can provide an updated exhibit and a separate contact list for SOC2 evidence requests.

Quick notes / next steps:
1) I'm attaching a draft "subprocessor-exhibit-v2.pdf" to this thread for your checklist review. It includes vendor, country, and a short processing purpose column.
2) Our legal team (cc'd) will send a redline to the DPA exhibit this afternoon for your counsel to review.
3) For SOC2 evidence, Laura will share an evidence contact and an exportable CSV of processor contacts.

Would you be available for a 20-min sync at 2pm PT to walk through any gaps? If not, we'll capture answers over email.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: subprocessor-exhibit-v2.pdf (application/pdf)

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme-corp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: updated subprocessor exhibit for procurement checklist

Hi Marta, Jordan —

Attached is a proposed redline to Exhibit A (file: redwood-dpa-exhibit-A-redline.docx). High-level summary of edits: 

- Clarified the distinction between "persistent content processing" and "runtime/telemetry processing" in the purpose column.
- Committed to 30-day notice for non-critical subprocessor changes; critical vendor additions will be notified within 5 business days.
- Added a minimal-privilege statement for telemetry processors that only need aggregated metrics.

A few open items I'd appreciate Acme counsel's input on: 
- Is a 30-day general notice acceptable for your procurement workflows, or do you need different timing for certain categories?
- For onshore-only commitments, we can add region pins per account via the DPA addendum; we need to know which products require it.

I'll leave Laura to send the evidence contact CSV.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-dpa-exhibit-A-redline.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

---
From: Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: updated subprocessor exhibit for procurement checklist

Thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifying questions from Acme Legal after reviewing the exhibit and redline: 

1) The analytics vendor "MetricPulse" is listed as processing aggregated telemetry in EU and US. Does MetricPulse ever receive full request payloads for debugging or root-cause analysis? If so, are those exports logged and retained, and where?

2) For our audit scope, we need a named contact at Redwood who can provide (on request) SOC2 evidence for the processing vendors. Can you provide a single point of contact and an approximate SLA for evidence requests (e.g., 7-10 business days)?

3) The redline references a 30-day notice for non-critical changes. For our internal procurement tracker we've flagged any vendor classified as "processing user content" — can you confirm the list of those vendors so we can mark them for expedited review?

I've attached our procurement tracker export (Acme_procurement_tracker.csv). Let us know if you prefer a quick call this afternoon.

Best,
Diego Ruiz
Deputy GC, Acme Corporation

Attachment: Acme_procurement_tracker.csv (text/csv)

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@acme-corp.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: updated subprocessor exhibit for procurement checklist

Diego — thanks for the questions. Answers below and next steps.

1) MetricPulse: 
- MetricPulse only receives aggregated telemetry by default.
- In exceptional debugging cases, they may receive sanitized request snippets (no PII, no full user message payloads) under an internal debug flow. Those exports are transient and stored in MetricPulse's US bucket for a maximum of 72 hours unless an export is required for a security investigation.

2) SOC2 evidence contact & SLA:
- Primary contact: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> (she's cc'd).
- SLA: we typically fulfill evidence requests within 7-10 business days; if Acme flags the request as audit-critical we will prioritize and aim for 3-5 business days.

3) Vendors processing user content (expedited review):
- EdgeStore Inc. (onshore US) — content storage for snapshots
- TokenVault Ltd. (onshore, encrypted key management)
- AssistAI (support transcript processing — limited retention)

Attached is an export of processor contacts and primary regions: "evidence-processor-contacts.csv".

Next steps: 
- Kimberly: if you can confirm the 30-day vs 5-day language, we'll finalize the redline and send a clean exhibit.
- Marta/Diego: please confirm if any of the three vendors above should be escalated to the 5-day notice bucket for Acme's procurement rules.
- I'll schedule a 20-min sync for tomorrow at 10am PT if that works for everyone; else let me know alternatives.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-processor-contacts.csv (text/csv)
